def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = case["required_symbols"]
    # Build node map and children map
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        node_map[nid] = node
        children[nid] = []
    for node in nodes:
        pid = node.get("parent")
        if pid is not None and pid in children:
            children[pid].append(node["id"])
    # Initialize retained set
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removed = []
    # Sort node IDs by depth descending, then ID ascending
    sorted_ids = sorted(node_map.keys(), key=lambda nid: (-node_map[nid]["depth"], nid))
    for nid in sorted_ids:
        if nid not in retained:
            continue
        node = node_map[nid]
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        if node["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # Check retained children
        has_retained_children = any(cid in retained for cid in children.get(nid, []))
        if has_retained_children:
            continue
        # Remove
        retained.remove(nid)
        removed.append(nid)
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed, "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted}
